6:

asking to "borrow some colored pencils,"
so I wondered what you were up to...
7:
You just wanted to draw pictures? And
why here, anyway?
8: I'm not drawing pictures! It's homework!
10: (It just looks like scribbles to me...)
11:
Yep! It's homework, okay? Special
homework, just for me! My teacher came up
with it!
13:
Uh-huh! "Draw pictures of two things you
love"! That's my homework!
16:
Maybe my teacher noticed my hidden tal-ent
or something! Mufufufu!
18: Right, right?! You think so too, don't you?
20:
(Having to set homework at her level... Her
teacher sure has it rough...)
21:
Done! Look! Look! It's a masterpiece,
right?!
22:
Y-yeah. It's a masterpiece. By the way,
Astraea? Can I ask you one thing?
24: What... is this a picture of?
25:
Whaaaat~?! You can't tell by looking?
Unbelievable! Are you stupid?!
26:
Who're you calling stupid?! It's just a
triangle and an oval! How's anyone
supposed to know what it is?!
27:
What are you talking about?! It's obviously
a rice ball and a croquette! Can't you tell?
28:
A rice ball and... a croquette? ...Oh,
r-right... I see. So that's the triangle and
the oval...
29:
Yes! Finally get it? Jeez! You just don't
understand Aht!

(How do I put it... Seriously, her teacher
must have it rough...)
